Terms and Conditions of the Contracts & Scope of Work: 1. Party’s service representative will check, test, correct and calibrate Weighing Syste m covered in the contract at customer site. 2. Four times maintenance visit per year and Breakdown visit will be taken up as and when required, when any breakdown occurs. 3. Under the normal circumstances service representative will be carry out the following: a) The visual inspection and testing of equipment under normal operating conditions. b) Inspection and adjustment of load cell assemblies. c) Testing of load cell resistance. d) Inspection of all system interface and earthing connections. e) Inspection of Indicators, Controllers, Optional cards, Control Panels and cables. f) Identification and advice on necessary repairs and replacement matters. g) Checking of system configuration parameters. h) Checking the mechanical assemblies and load cells mounting arrangements. g) Calibration of weighing system with standard weights h) Modifications if any, as per process requirements 4. Minebea Intec service representative will carry normal tool kit like soldering iron, D igital Multimeter etc. However, the HCL will provide standard Weights, Welding mac hine, gas cutter, heavy tools and tackles and unskilled manpower whenever the wei ghing system needs recalibration and /or mechanical adjustment. 5. For repairs necessitating the removal of equipment or any parts thereof to the repa ir Center, there shall be no additional labour charges / incidental expenses for the re pair. 6. Breakdown call should attend within 72 Hrs after logging complaint by HCL-MCP pe rsonal. 7. Standard working hours will be 08:00-18:00, Monday – Saturday. Breakdown visit c an be scheduled on Sunday/Public Holiday as per requirement/urgency. 8. The maintenance schedule for each quarter will be mutually agreed 2 weeks in adv ance. Once schedule is confirmed, maintenance will proceed over consecutive week days until completed. 9. AMC shall also include all major repairs, replacements; upgrades including softwar e/hardware programming and modification. All Tools/tackles/communication cables/ software required for such jobs shall be arranged by the vendor. 10.Only competent service engineer shall visit in AMC visits who shall be having thoro ugh knowledge and know-how of the system. 11.The vendor shall submit a list of critical spares in advance, likely to be consumed d uring the AMC period. 12.Provision of remote support services from OEMs/supplier for any fault finding shall also be under the scope of AMC. 13.AMC provider shall be responsible to optimize equipment performance, maximize p roduction output with premium quality and minimize maintenance costs HCL Scope : 1. Required standard weights for calibration and unskilled manpower for handling will be in HCL’s scope. 2. However, the HCL will provide Welding machine, gas cutter, heavy tools and tackle s and respective manpower whenever the weighing system needs recalibration and /or mechanical adjustment.

3. HCL/MCP will provide a safe, free and uninterrupted access to the maintenance sit e. HCL/MCP will remove any obstructions necessary to allow equipment maintenanc e. . CONTRACT PERIOD The period of work shall be for 24 months. However, the same can be extended for fu rther period (i.e. 25% of quantity) at the same rates, terms and conditions at the discre tion of HCL/MCP. In case of extension of time schedule the contractor will have to abide by the same. PERFORMANCE SECURITY (SECURITY DEPOSIT) 7.1 The successful Tenderer shall deposit an amount equivalent to 10% of the total Contract/ Work Orde r value including GST. 7.2 Out of this, the initial Security Deposit will amount to 5% of the total Contract/ Work Order value including GST. The Initial Security Deposit is to be deposited by the successful Tenderer within 30 (Thirty) days from th e date issue of Letter of Intent/Work Order, whichever is earlier, in the form of Insurance Security Bond/ /NEFT /RTGS/Fixed Deposit Receipt/Bank Guarantee (on HCL’s format) from a Scheduled Commercial Bank except C o-operative and Gramin Bank for Goods/Services/Works/EPC Contracts. In case of Bank Guarantee, it has to b e as per HCL’s prescribed format. 7.3 The Security Deposit equivalent to the balance 5% of the total Contract/ Work Order value including GST will be recovered from the progressive bills of the contractor @10% from each RA Bill. However, after every si x months, 50% of the accumulated retention money can be refunded to the contractor against submission of equivalent amount of Bank Guarantee (BG) from scheduled commercial bank. 7.4 HCL is at liberty, after having given fourteen (14) days written notice to the contractor, to realize and/or f or unsatisfactory performance of the contract or any clauses thereof. 7.5 The above security amount shall remain fixed during the entire period of the contract irrespective of any decrease/increase in the value of contract due to any reason like increase/decrease in labour wages, price in dices, change order, etc., during the execution of the contract. 7.6 In case the Security Deposit is furnished by way of Bank Guarantee, it must be initially valid for the entire contract period plus Defect Liability Period (DLP) plus 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractua l obligations of the Contractor/contractor, including warranty obligations. 7.7 A penal interest @18% per annum shall be collected from the bidders on a pro-rata basis on account of a ny delay towards submission of SD/ Bank Guarantee amount after the assigned period of 30 days. 7.8 Only after submission of SD, the EMD of Successful Bidder will be refunded. 7.9 Payment of Contractor will be withheld until receipt of Performance Security/ Security Deposit. 7.10 The bank A/C details for RTGS/NEFT payment are as under: IFSC Code: SBIN0004510 A/C Type: Current Account A/C No.: 11290757078 A/C Name: Hindustan Copper Limited 7.11 The method of submission of Bank Guarantee is as below: The bank guarantee issued by the issuing bank on behalf of the Contractor in favour of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) shall be in hard copy in original on stamp paper as well as Structured Financial Messaging System (SFMS).
